description: This file defines functions and utilities for performing automated user actions in a browser context, such as clicking, filling forms, asserting conditions, and navigating, within the Playwright testing framework. It includes logic for executing actions based on their type and constructing options for mouse interactions.

classes.name: Progress
classes.description: Represents a progress indicator for asynchronous actions.

classes.name: ProgressController
classes.description: Controls the execution of progress-based actions, providing a run method.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Executes a specified user action within a given page context, handling different action types such as navigation, clicks, form interactions, and assertions.

methods.name: performActionImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation that performs the specific action based on its type, using the mainFrame object to interact with the page.

methods.name: toClickOptions
methods.description: Constructs mouse click options based on the action parameters, including button type, modifiers, click count, and position.
